conversations.title: Family Photo
conversations.scene: Two people look at a family picture.
conversations.sampleContext: They ask who the people are.

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: これは私の家族です。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: この人はどなたですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: 父です。そして母です。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: あの男の人は兄ですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: はい、兄です。あの女の人は姉です。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: 子供もいますか。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: はい、弟と妹がいます。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: 大きい家族ですね。

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: Is that man over there your older brother?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Yes, he is my older brother. That woman over there is my older sister.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Yes, my younger brother and younger sister are there.

listeningQuestions: Who are the first two people Speaker 1 identifies?
Is the man over there Speaker 1's older brother?
Who is the woman over there?
Which younger family members does Speaker 1 mention?
answerKey: Yes, he is her older brother.
Her younger brother and younger sister.

conversations.title: Red or Blue
conversations.scene: Two people choose between red and blue things.
conversations.sampleContext: They are looking at two items nearby.

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: これとそれ、どれがいいですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: その赤いのがいいです。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: ああ、赤が好きですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: はい、好きです。でも青も好きです。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: 私は青いのが好きです。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: あれは古いですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: はい、あれは古いです。でも悪いではありません。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: いいですね。

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: This and that, which is good?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: Yes, I like it. But I like blue too.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: Is that one over there old?

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Yes, that one is old. But it is not bad.

listeningQuestions: Which color does Speaker 2 choose first?
What does Speaker 2 ask about the thing over there?
Does Speaker 1 say the old thing is bad?
answerKey: He asks whether it is old.
No, she says it is old but not bad.

conversations.title: Morning Greeting
conversations.scene: Two people greet each other in the morning.

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: おはようございます。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: おはようございます。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: ああ、田中です。初めまして。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: 初めまして。佐藤です。よろしくお願いします。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: あなたは学生ですか。

text.speaker: Speaker 1
text.japanese: はい、学生です。先生ではありません。

text.speaker: Speaker 2
text.japanese: そうですか。どうぞよろしく。

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Oh, I am Tanaka. Nice to meet you.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 2
englishTranslation.english: Nice to meet you. I am Sato. Please treat me well.

englishTranslation.speaker: Speaker 1
englishTranslation.english: Yes, I am a student. I am not a teacher.

listeningQuestions: What time greeting do they use?
How does Speaker 2 end the conversation?
answerKey: No, she is a student, not a teacher.
He says please treat me well / regards.
